prospective_ceiling_scope_default: Entire commission-wide arm attribution across all conditions, orders and replications, including that arm's allocated evaluation/retry usage; no automatic per-condition reset
retry_policy: At most three transient retries per logical call, subject to the smaller global reserved-attempt/token pool; no retries for substantive or malformed answers. Uncertain execution is not silently replayed.

replay_forecast_assumptions.meaning: Hypothetical sensitivity inputs, not measured decomposition of the qualification or estimates of protected document lengths

hard_envelope_assumptions.reasoning_tokens_in_output: Must be verified for actual telemetry; if disjoint, add explicit reasoning bound or refuse dispatch

stage2_forecast.allocation: Half of shared blinding cost to each reasoning arm; all candidate-specific costs to generating arm
stage2_forecast.candidate_cap_policy: Capacity assumption, never silent top-k selection; if exceeded, hold all candidates pending operator-authorized additional capacity
stage2_forecast.external_human_review_cost: Not tokenized here; reviewer time, credentials and formal verification must be budgeted separately
